description: Defines classes and methods for asynchronous disk cache I/O operations in the Chromium project, including BackendIO and InFlightBackendIO, with operations like open, create, doom, read, write, and range queries.

classes.name: BackendIO
classes.description: Represents a single asynchronous disk cache I/O operation, supporting various cache operations and callbacks.

classes.name: InFlightBackendIO
classes.description: Manages multiple concurrent BackendIO operations, providing methods to initiate, cancel, and wait for I/O tasks.

methods.name: BackendIO::ExecuteOperation
methods.description: Runs the actual cache operation on a background thread.

methods.name: BackendIO::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of an I/O operation.

methods.name: InFlightBackendIO::DoomEntriesBetween
methods.description: Deletes cache entries within a specified time range.
